MINUTES FINAL
                      Girdwood Trails Committee Regular Meeting
                             Tuesday, January 6 2026 7:00PM
Girdwood Trails Committee meetings are taking place on Teams with in-person attendance at the Girdwood Community
Room, 250 Egloff Rd.

GTC Voting members are defined as any person eighteen (18) years of age or older who has attended one or more Trails Committee
meetings in the last 12 months, and is:
a)      a current resident and/or property owner, business owner or designated representative of a non-profit association; and
b)     who has resided in, owned property in, owned a business located in, or operated as a non-profit association for the preceding
ninety (90) days or longer in Girdwood Valley.
Attendance is verified through a sign-in sheet available at each meeting, or equivalent process.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors, its committees, and subcommittees are subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in
Alaska Statute 44.62.310 and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Trails Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7:03PM Barb Crews
Approval of Jan 6 2026 meeting agenda                                      Brodin/P Crews                  Assent
Amended during meeting to move item #8 to Old Business by unanimous vote
Approval of December 2 2025 meeting minutes                      P Crews/Sandberg               Assent

Announcements & Presentations:
Girdwood Parks Master Plan https://girdwoodparksplan.com/ project is on-going. Open house #2 was held Dec 16.

Introductions: No new members noted

Public Comment (3 minutes each): None

Old Business:
     1.  GTC Officer Elections for 2026: Positions are Chair, 2 Vice Chairs, Treasurer
        Barb Crews Nominated for Chair        P Crews/Brodin          Nomination accepted
         Brian Burnett nominated for Vice Chair    B Crews/P Crews        Nomination accepted
         Patty Hamre nominated for Vice Chair     B Crews/P Crews        Nomination accepted
      No nominations for Treasurer.

         Motion:
      GTC moves that the officers for 2026 are as follows:
        Barb Crews, Chair; Brian Burnett and Patty Hamre, Vice Chairs
        Motion by P Crews, 2nd P Hamre
        Motion carries by assent

     2.  Rewrite of Open Meetings Act information on GTC agenda

         Motion:
      GTC moves to remove language about the Open Meetings Act and retain the sentence: The Girdwood Trails Committee
        operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.
        Motion by K Sandberg, 2nd Brodin
        Motion carries by Assent vote

     3.  Holtan Hills Development Phase 1 CU/PUD and Middle Iditarod National Historic Trail reroute (Brian)
        Mike Edgington attended the Planning and Zoning Commission meeting on MON Jan 5. Result of trails items at P&Z was that
      CY Investments will pay for realignment of the trail and trail easement through Phase 1 of the Holtan Hills Development.
         Actual language of this will be presented at P&Z next meeting for final review and vote.





              Girdwood Trails Committee Agendas and minutes are available on line: www.muni.org/gtc

                                                                                1

4.  Update on Winner Creek Trail Bridge at Glacier Creek
         Project is planned to go out to bid in January for construction as designed and approved by GTC and USFS. Letter received
        from USFS regarding collaboration with MOA on the project has been received. Once constructed, the bridge will be turned
        over to USFS for operation and maintenance. Design meets USFS requirements. Once bids have been received, firm budget
           will be known for this mainly steel construction project. Capital campaign may be initiated to fill any gaps.

     5.  Consider Community Trails Info message for upcoming month to be shared on social media
         Additional snow needed before grooming in meadows will begin. Storm later this week should provide this additional coverage.
        There will be challenges with the ice buildup in some overflow locations due to long duration of cold weather without snow
        coverage.

     6.  Girdwood Trails Management Plan Revision and Review
        Appendices 5,6,7 were discussed in December and amended for this meeting.
       Review new drafts of Appendices 3,4
         Introduction of Appendix 8, which catalogs all land management agreements and easements.
        Status of Appendix 1 (maps) and Appendix 2 (list and descriptions of trails): These two appendices are pending.

        Request for approval of appendices 3-7 at the Feb GTC meeting.

     7.  Girdwood Comprehensive Plan RE Parcel 6-011 and Upper Valley Trails
        Item is addressed in HLB 5 year plan. Plan has been approved by HLBAC and is moving forward to Assembly for introduction
          in January with likely Assembly approval in February.

     8.  GTC application for National Forest Foundation Matching Awards Program (MAP) Grant for MINHT work. Project is
         continuation of Middle Iditarod National Historic Trail work, which is an established and on-going project of GTC.

         Motion:
      GTC moves item from new business to old due to time constraints as application is due in January.
        Motion by P Crews/P Hamre
        Motion carries by Assent vote

         Motion:
      GTC moves to support staff work on National Forest Foundation MAP Grant for Middle Iditarod NHT trail improvements, which
         requires a 1:1 match of private funds.
        Motion by P Crews, 2nd P Hamre
        Motion carries by Assent vote

New Business:

Other:
     9.  Ongoing Trails Issues for update:
             •    Trails maps: Met with contractor in December. When updated draft is received map committee will be requested to
              meet and review. In the meantime, the materials have been received to use the new map display at the 5K. Plan is to
                 post a GNSC winter map of the area for this season.
             •   Status of Trails grants: discussed
             •   Other Trails Issues: Additional signage needed to protect 5K for ski only/no dogs
             •   Winter grooming: Underway. Need additional coverage for snow machine grooming on meadows as the cold dry
              snow so far this year doesn’t provide lasting coverage.

    10. Monthly LUC/GBOS Meeting Representatives:
    11. Written Reports should be submitted to include in meeting packet
Adjourn 8PM
